// Article-specific bespoke detection — A Forgotten Contributor Account Compromised the Entire Mastra npm Package Scope
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("dayjs.min.js") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\ProgramData\NodePackages"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\ProgramData\NodePackages", "/Library/LaunchAgents/com.nvm.protocal.plist", "/dev/null") or FileName in~ ("dayjs.min.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

3025.sent:
let Window = 10m;   // attacker probes auth then bypasses within minutes
let Failures = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has "/v1/"
    | where HttpStatusCode in (401, 403)
    | project FailTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, FailUrl = Url, DstHostname;
let Success = ImWebSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where Url has "/v1/"
    | where HttpStatusCode in (200, 201)
    | project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SuccessUrl = Url, SuccessHost = HttpHostName, DstHostname;
Failures
| join kind=inner Success on SrcIpAddr
| where SuccessTime between (FailTime .. FailTime + Window)
| project FailTime, SuccessTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', SuccessTime, FailTime),
          SrcIpAddr, FailUrl, SuccessUrl, SuccessHost, DstHostname
| order by SuccessTime desc
3025.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) as failTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=401 OR Web.status=403) by Web.src
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src
    [| tstats `summariesonly` earliest(_time) as successTime from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*/v1/*" (Web.status=200 OR Web.status=201) by Web.src
     | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`]
| where successTime > failTime AND successTime <= failTime + 600
| eval delaySec = successTime - failTime
| convert ctime(failTime) ctime(successTime)
| table failTime, successTime, delaySec, src
| sort - successTime

description: Detects DeleteBucket/DeleteObject(s) against an S3 bucket whose name indicates it stores CloudTrail/audit logs, destroying the log destination.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/cloud-logging-defense-evasion/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/008/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/26
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1562.008
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  product: aws
  service: cloudtrail
detection:
  selection:
    eventSource: s3.amazonaws.com
    eventName:
      - DeleteBucket
      - DeleteObject
      - DeleteObjects
  bucket_scope:
    requestParameters.bucketName|contains:
      - cloudtrail
      - log
      - audit
      - trail
  condition: selection and bucket_scope
falsepositives:
  - Lifecycle cleanup of expired log buckets by platform team
level: high
3092.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Change where (All_Changes.command IN ("DeleteBucket","DeleteObject","DeleteObjects")) AND All_Changes.status="success" AND (All_Changes.object IN ("*cloudtrail*","*log*","*audit*","*trail*")) by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command All_Changes.object All_Changes.src | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
3092.datadog: source:cloudtrail @evt.name:(DeleteBucket OR DeleteObject OR DeleteObjects) @requestParameters.bucketName:(*cloudtrail* OR *log* OR *audit* OR *trail*) @evt.outcome:success
3092.cloudwatch:
# log group: /aws/cloudtrail
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.bucketName, awsRegion
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com"
      and eventName in ["DeleteBucket", "DeleteObject", "DeleteObjects"]
      and (requestParameters.bucketName like /cloudtrail/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /log/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /audit/i or requestParameters.bucketName like /trail/i)
      and not isPresent(errorCode)
| sort @timestamp desc

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/hosts/[^/]+/reenroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | extend VictimHostId = extract(@"/api/v1/hosts/([^/]+)/reenroll", 1, csUriStem)
    | project ReenrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent = csUserAgent;

    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where csMethod == "POST"
    | where csUriStem matches regex @"^/api/v1/enroll/?$"
    | where scStatus in (200, 201)
    | project EnrollTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, cIP, EnrollAgent = csUserAgent;
Reenroll
| join kind=inner Enroll on cIP, Computer
| where EnrollTime between (ReenrollTime .. ReenrollTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EnrollTime, ReenrollTime)
| extend CVE = "CVE-2026-47724"
| project ReenrollTime, EnrollTime, DelaySec, Computer, cIP, csUserName, VictimHostId, ReenrollAgent, EnrollAgent, CVE

// Article-specific bespoke detection — [GHSA / CRITICAL] CVE-2026-44182: Jupyter Enterprise Gateway: Kubernetes Manifes
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("launch_kubernetes.py"))

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/home/jovyan") or FileName in~ ("launch_kubernetes.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes

       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path

3167.sent:
// Detects KERNEL_* env-var with YAML-injection markers in EG application syslog or WAF body logs.
// CommonSecurityLog does NOT carry DeviceName — use DestinationHostName / SourceIP for host pivots.
let InjectionMarkers = @"(?i)KERNEL_[A-Z_]+[^\n]{0,200}(---|\.\.\.|securityContext|runAsUser|runAsGroup|fsGroup|privileged\s*:\s*true)";
union isfuzzy=true
(
  Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where ProcessName has_any ("enterprise_gateway", "enterprise-gateway", "jupyter") or SyslogMessage has "/api/kernels"
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=Computer, HostName, ProcessName, Evidence=SyslogMessage
),
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestURL has "/api/kernels" and RequestMethod =~ "POST"
  | where Message matches regex InjectionMarkers or DeviceCustomString1 matches regex InjectionMarkers or AdditionalExtensions matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="WAF/Proxy", Host=DestinationHostName, SourceIP=SourceIP, ProcessName=DeviceProduct, Evidence=coalesce(Message, DeviceCustomString1, AdditionalExtensions)
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csUriStem == "/api/kernels" and csMethod =~ "POST"
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="IIS", Host=Computer, SourceIP=cIP, ProcessName="w3wp", Evidence=strcat(csMethod, " ", csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery)
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| join type=inner src dest [ search (sourcetype=nginx:plus:access OR sourcetype=ingress:nginx OR sourcetype=kube:container:enterprise-gateway OR sourcetype=istio:envoy:access) "/api/kernels" "KERNEL_" ("---" OR "..." OR "securityContext" OR "runAsUser" OR "fsGroup" OR "privileged") | table _time src dest _raw ]
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)

3168.sigma:
title: Privileged Pod Created by Jupyter Enterprise Gateway ServiceAccount (CVE-2026-44182)
id: 7e2a9c4b-1d8f-4a3e-9b6c-5f0a8d2e1c7f
description: Detects pod creation by the enterprise-gateway ServiceAccount whose spec contains privileged true, runAsUser 0, hostNetwork true, hostPID true, or a hostPath volume — the post-exploitation footprint of CVE-2026-44182 Jinja2 YAML injection.
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cfw7-6c5v-2wjq
  - https://github.com/jupyter-server/enterprise_gateway/blob/152c20f162f2fab700c04c8830ebf8c1e2e2217a/etc/kernel-launchers/kubernetes/scripts/kernel-pod.yaml.j2#L77
author: ucs-pipeline
date: 2026/06/04
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1611
  - attack.t1068
  - attack.privilege_escalation
  - attack.initial_access
logsource:
  product: kubernetes
  service: audit
detection:
  selection:
    verb: create
    objectRef.resource: pods
    stage: ResponseComplete
    user.username|contains: 'enterprise-gateway'
    requestObject|contains:
      - '"privileged":true'
      - '"runAsUser":0'
      - '"runAsGroup":0'
      - '"hostNetwork":true'
      - '"hostPID":true'
      - 'hostPath'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Intentional administrator override re-deployment of EG with privileged kernel launchers (rare and should already be on a change record)
level: high
3168.spl:
search (sourcetype=kube:apiserver:audit OR sourcetype="aws:cloudwatchlogs:eks" OR sourcetype="aks:audit" OR sourcetype="gcp:gke:audit")
  verb=create "objectRef.resource"=pods stage=ResponseComplete
  ("user.username"=*enterprise-gateway* OR "user.username"="system:serviceaccount:enterprise-gateway:enterprise-gateway*" OR "impersonatedUser.username"=*enterprise-gateway*)
  ("\"privileged\":true" OR "\"runAsUser\":0" OR "\"runAsGroup\":0" OR "\"hostNetwork\":true" OR "\"hostPID\":true" OR "hostPath")
| spath input=_raw
| eval podName=coalesce('objectRef.name','requestObject.metadata.name'), ns='objectRef.namespace', sa='user.username'
| stats min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(podName) as podName values(ns) as namespace values(sourceIPs{}) as src by sa, host
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| where mvcount(podName) >= 1
3168.datadog: source:kubernetes.audit @verb:create @objectRef.resource:pods @stage:ResponseComplete @user.username:*enterprise-gateway* (@requestObject.spec.securityContext.runAsUser:0 OR @requestObject.spec.securityContext.runAsGroup:0 OR @requestObject.spec.containers.securityContext.privileged:true OR @requestObject.spec.hostNetwork:true OR @requestObject.spec.hostPID:true OR @requestObject.spec.volumes.hostPath.path:*)

let bunUrlIndicators = dynamic(["github.com/oven-sh/bun", "oven-sh/bun/releases", "bun-windows-x64", "bun-linux-x64", "bun-darwin"]);
let npmParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.exe"]);
let downloaderChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","curl.exe","powershell.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
// Process-tree pivot — npm parent spawning a downloader child with Bun URL on the command line
let ProcHits = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents)
    | where FileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (bunUrlIndicators)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage  = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage = FileName,
              ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
// Network pivot — same process families connecting to github.com for the Bun release tarball
let NetHits = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where RemoteUrl has "github.com" and (RemoteUrl has "oven-sh/bun" or RemoteUrl has "bun-windows" or RemoteUrl has "bun-linux" or RemoteUrl has "bun-darwin")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (downloaderChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (npmParents) or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (npmParents)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitImage   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitCmd     = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = "<network-egress>", ChildCmd = RemoteUrl, SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
union ProcHits, NetHits
| order by Timestamp desc

id: 9e1b4a7c-8f60-1b9d-2e3c-4a517c1b9d2e
description: Detects the redhat-cloud-services Stage 4 implant pattern — Bun binary located in /tmp executing /tmp/p<random>.js, invoked from a node/npm parent.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/multiple-redhat-cloud-services-npm-packages-compromised
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/06/01
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1140
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_bun_in_tmp:
    Image|re: '^/tmp/[^/]+/bun$'
  selection_runs_p_js:
    CommandLine|re: '/tmp/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js'
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/npm'
  condition: (selection_bun_in_tmp or selection_parent) and selection_runs_p_js
level: critical
3190.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="/tmp/*/bun" OR Processes.process_path="/tmp/*/bun.exe" OR Processes.process_name="bun") Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node","npm","node.exe") Processes.process="*/tmp/p*.js*" by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
3190.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE ((@process.executable.path:/tmp/*/bun AND @process.command_line:*/tmp/p*.js*) OR (@process.parent.name:(node OR npm OR bun) AND @process.command_line:(*/tmp/bun*/tmp/p*.js* OR *bun */tmp/p*.js*)))
3190.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/^\/tmp\/[^\/]+\/bun$/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/^bun$/i)
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(node|npm|bun)$/i
| regex("\\/tmp\\/p[A-Za-z0-9]+\\.js", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())

3193.sigma:
title: PHP CLI Drops Hidden Payload to /tmp (Laravel-Lang Composer SC)
id: 4c1bd2e5-9a47-4f8e-8d3a-7c8b2e3f4a5d
description: Detects a php process writing a hidden dropper to /tmp/.laravel_locale/<hex>.php or /tmp/.<hex>, matching the Laravel-Lang Composer supply-chain helpers.php payload that uses bin2hex(random_bytes(6)) for filename generation.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/laravel-lang-supply-chain-attack
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23
tags:
  - attack.t1564.001
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.t1204.003
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|re: '/php[0-9]?$'
  selection_path:
    - TargetFilename|startswith: '/tmp/.laravel_locale/'
    - TargetFilename|re: '^/tmp/\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}$'
    - TargetFilename|re: '^/tmp/\.[a-f0-9]+/[a-f0-9]{6,12}\.php$'
  condition: selection_image and selection_path
level: high
3193.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action=created AND (Filesystem.file_path="/tmp/.laravel_locale/*" OR Filesystem.file_path="/tmp/.*") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("php","php7","php8","php-cli") by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name, Filesystem.process_path, Filesystem.file_name, Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | rex field=file_name "^(?<basename>\.?[a-f0-9]{6,12}(?:\.php)?)$" | where isnotnull(basename) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
3193.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/\/(php[0-9]?|php-cli)$/i
| (regex("^/tmp/\\.laravel_locale/[a-f0-9]{6,12}\\.php$", field=TargetFileName) OR regex("^/tmp/\\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}$", field=TargetFileName))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())

id: 5e2c3d4f-6a7b-8c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
description: Detects a process whose parent is systemd/init (reparented ppid=1) running from /tmp/.<hex> or whose command line references the Laravel-Lang stage-2 hidden dropper path. The article notes both an orphaned php and an unnamed ELF process executing from a now-deleted /tmp path.

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/23

    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/systemd'
      - '/init'
  selection_target:
    - Image|re: '^/tmp/\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}$'
    - CommandLine|re: '/tmp/\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}(\.php)?'

level: high

(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 OR #event_simpleName=SyntheticProcessRollup2) ParentBaseFileName=/^(systemd|init)$/i
| (regex("^/tmp/\\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}$", field=ImageFileName) OR regex("/tmp/\\.[a-f0-9]{6,12}(\\.php)?", field=CommandLine) OR regex("^/tmp/\\.laravel_locale/", field=ImageFileName))

3195.spl:
index=* sourcetype IN ("github:audit","github_audit_log","github:enterprise:audit") (action="git.push" OR action="git.create" OR action="protected_branch.policy_override") ref="refs/tags/*"
| eval repo_org=mvindex(split(repo,"/"),0)
| stats min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(repo) as repo_count dc(ref) as tag_count values(repo) as repos values(ref) as refs by actor, repo_org
| eval window_seconds = last_seen - first_seen
